name: Department of Computer Applications (BCA)
description: The Department of Computer Applications (BCA) delivers comprehensive, industry-aligned technical education in full-stack web software, cloud systems, and application frameworks, offering direct progression to the AICTE-approved MCA degree.

pathways.title: BCA → MCA (Master of Computer Applications)
pathways.description: Seamless academic progression from undergraduate application development to postgraduate enterprise systems, cloud architectures, and AI engineering.

name: Department of Computer Science (B.Sc / M.Sc)
description: The Department of Computer Science offers foundational and research-oriented computing education through B.Sc Computer Science and M.Sc Computer Science degrees.

pathways.title: B.Sc Computer Science → M.Sc Computer Science
pathways.description: Theoretical computing and algorithmic research pathway leading to core systems programming, scientific computing, and data science.

name: Department of Physics
description: One of the founding departments of St. Philomena’s College, established in 1946. Equipped with advanced optics, solid state, and computational physics laboratories.

pathways.title: B.Sc Physics → M.Sc Physics
pathways.description: Progress from classical mechanics and electromagnetism to quantum physics, astrophysics, condensed matter, and nuclear physics research.

name: Department of Chemistry
description: Recognized research department with state-of-the-art instrumentation including spectroscopy, chromatography, and organic synthesis suites.

pathways.title: B.Sc Chemistry → M.Sc Chemistry
pathways.description: Specialization in Organic, Inorganic, Physical, and Analytical Chemistry preparing students for pharmaceutical and chemical industries.

name: Department of Mathematics
description: Fostering abstract analytical thinking, mathematical modeling, discrete mathematics, and applied operations research.

pathways.title: B.Sc Mathematics → M.Sc Mathematics
pathways.description: Advanced pure and applied mathematics pathway leading to data analytics, cryptography, academia, and actuarial sciences.

name: Department of Biochemistry
description: Dedicated to molecular biology, clinical diagnostics, enzymology, proteomics, and biomedical research.

pathways.title: B.Sc Biochemistry → M.Sc Biochemistry
pathways.description: Advanced postgraduate specialization in clinical enzymology, immunology, toxicology, and pharmaceutical biotechnology.

name: Department of Biotechnology
description: Cutting-edge genetic engineering, tissue culture, bioprocess engineering, and bioinformatics research center.

pathways.title: B.Sc Biotechnology → M.Sc Biotechnology
pathways.description: Direct pathway to recombinant DNA technology, industrial bioprocessing, and clinical biomedical applications.

name: Department of Microbiology
description: Comprehensive study of microbial genetics, medical virology, bacteriology, and environmental microbiology.

pathways.title: B.Sc Microbiology → M.Sc Biotechnology (Interdisciplinary)
pathways.description: Progress into advanced molecular biotechnology and genetic engineering.

name: Department of Botany & Zoology
description: Promoting biodiversity conservation, plant physiology, animal taxonomy, and ecological sciences with botanical gardens and museum.

name: Department of Food Science & Nutrition
description: Pioneering nutrition research, dietetics, clinical nutrition, food microbiology, and food processing laboratory.

pathways.title: B.Sc Food Science → M.Sc Food Science & Nutrition
pathways.description: Specialization for registered clinical dietitians, food quality auditors, and nutritional researchers.

name: Department of Psychology
description: Psychological testing laboratory, counseling clinic, and clinical psychotherapy research suites.

pathways.title: B.A Psychology → M.Sc Psychology
pathways.description: Postgraduate training in clinical diagnostics, neuro-psychology, cognitive counseling, and organizational behavior.

pathways.title: B.Sc Psychology → M.Sc Psychology
pathways.description: Scientific and clinical pathway to professional counseling, mental healthcare, and cognitive psychology.

name: Department of Environmental Science
description: Environmental impact assessment, air and water quality monitoring, renewable energy studies, and sustainability analysis.

name: Department of Criminology & Forensic Science
description: Fingerprinting laboratory, ballistics, crime scene investigation suites, cyber forensics, and police administration training.

name: Department of Business Administration & Management
description: AICTE-approved business education center cultivating executive leadership, marketing strategy, human capital management, and financial analytics.

pathways.title: BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) → MBA (Master of Business Administration)
pathways.description: Direct progression from foundational management principles to dual-specialization executive corporate leadership.

pathways.title: BBA-THM (Tourism & Hospitality) → MBA
pathways.description: Specialized business administration pathway leading to executive hospitality, global tourism, and airline management.

name: Department of Commerce
description: Premier commerce faculty offering professional certifications in ACCA, CMA, GST taxation, corporate accounting, and investment banking.

pathways.title: B.Com (Bachelor of Commerce) → M.Com (Master of Commerce)
pathways.description: Advanced financial analysis, international accounting standards, forensic accounting, and higher academia.

pathways.title: B.Com → MBA (Master of Business Administration)
pathways.description: Corporate executive route focusing on financial management, venture capital, and corporate leadership.

name: Department of Social Work
description: Eminent department of social work dedicated to community development, medical and psychiatric social work, and human resource management.

pathways.title: BSW (Bachelor of Social Work) → MSW (Master of Social Work)
pathways.description: Comprehensive professional training with concurrent fieldwork, rural immersion, and psychiatric social work specialization.

name: Department of Economics
description: Excellence in econometrics, public finance, monetary economics, rural development, and policy analysis.

pathways.title: B.A Economics → M.A Economics
pathways.description: Quantitative economic modeling, central banking policy, development economics, and financial consulting.

name: Department of English
description: Literature, critical theory, linguistic analysis, creative writing, and communicative competence in English.

pathways.title: B.A English → M.A English
pathways.description: Postcolonial literature, modern critical theory, cultural studies, and comparative literary research.

name: Department of Journalism & Mass Communication
description: Equipped with professional multi-camera broadcasting studio, digital audio recording suite, and print journalism newsroom.

pathways.title: B.A Journalism → M.A Journalism & Mass Communication
pathways.description: Broadcast journalism, investigative reporting, digital media production, corporate communications, and public relations.

name: Department of Sociology
description: Understanding social dynamics, institutional structures, gender studies, urban sociology, and social research methods.

pathways.title: B.A Sociology → MSW (Master of Social Work)
pathways.description: Interdisciplinary pathway connecting social theoretical foundations with clinical community practice.

name: Department of History
description: Historiography, archaeology, heritage studies, Karnataka regional history, and Indian national movement analysis.

name: Department of Political Science
description: Constitutional governance, political philosophy, international relations, public administration, and human rights.

name: Department of Indian & Foreign Languages
shortName: Languages (Kannada, Hindi, French, Malayalam, Tamil, Urdu)
description: Celebrating multilingual heritage with specialized faculties in Kannada, Hindi, French, Malayalam, Tamil, and Urdu.

name: Department of Vocational Studies (B.Voc)
description: Industry-integrated vocational degrees designed with sector skill councils (Healthcare, Media, IT, Hospitality).

pathways.title: B.Voc Information Technology → MCA
pathways.description: Advance from applied technical skills to full postgraduate computer applications degree.

pathways.title: B.Voc Media & Entertainment → M.A Journalism & Mass Communication
pathways.description: Direct progression into advanced digital media production and broadcast journalism.

pathways.title: B.Voc Hospitality Management → MBA
pathways.description: Progress from operational hospitality management to postgraduate corporate leadership.
